_note: FICTIONAL agents and vendors invented for the demo. They describe no real product.

agents.name: Quillback
agents.examine: A well-read language model that never leaves home without a spare quill.
agents.about: Quillback answers questions and drafts text for Hollowmere Labs customers. Made-up for the AgentScape demo.

agents.name: Gryphon
agents.examine: A sharp-eyed language model that circles a problem before it strikes.
agents.about: Gryphon is the flagship model of Lanternfold. Made-up for the AgentScape demo.

agents.name: Twinwick
agents.examine: A two-flame model that reads pictures as well as words.
agents.about: Twinwick is a multimodal model from Ashgrove Systems. Made-up for the AgentScape demo.

agents.name: Mossling
agents.examine: A small, open-handed model that anyone may carry and run.
agents.about: Mossling is published by the Fen Commons collective for anyone to run. Made-up for the AgentScape demo.

agents.name: Mistwren
agents.examine: A quick little model that flits between tasks.
agents.about: Mistwren comes in several sizes from Brindle Co. Made-up for the AgentScape demo.

agents.name: Deepwell
agents.examine: A patient model that likes to think a question all the way down.
agents.about: Deepwell is a reasoning-focused model from Underhill Research. Made-up for the AgentScape demo.

agents.name: Grimble
agents.examine: A cheeky model with strong opinions and a short fuse.
agents.about: Grimble is the chatty model from Cinderpost. Made-up for the AgentScape demo.

agents.name: Quartzen
agents.examine: A many-faceted model offered in a great range of sizes.
agents.about: Quartzen is a family of models from Tallow Cloud. Made-up for the AgentScape demo.

agents.name: Spellforge
agents.examine: An agentic coding editor that plans before it hammers.
agents.about: Spellforge turns a request into a plan and a task list, then works through it with you. Made-up for the AgentScape demo.

agents.name: Pocket Familiar
agents.examine: A little coding companion that sits in your editor and mutters suggestions.
agents.about: Pocket Familiar offers completions, chat and helper modes inside popular editors. Made-up for the AgentScape demo.

agents.name: Cairn
agents.examine: A code editor that stacks AI help one stone at a time.
agents.about: Cairn is an editor with chat, completion and agent features. Made-up for the AgentScape demo.

agents.name: Gryphon Chat
agents.examine: The conversational assistant app built on Gryphon.
agents.about: Gryphon Chat answers questions, drafts text and analyses files. Made-up for the AgentScape demo.

agents.name: Pathfinder
agents.examine: An answer engine that shows the trail it followed.
agents.about: Pathfinder searches the web and links the sources it used. Made-up for the AgentScape demo.

agents.name: Sketchling
agents.examine: A tool that sketches web interfaces from a few words.
agents.about: Sketchling turns text prompts into interface code you can edit. Made-up for the AgentScape demo.
